name: Taste of Thai
notes: All 3 photos are the same full printed menu. Photo 1 is a clear color scan with current prices; photos 2 and 3 are the same older menu (B&W scan and a phone photo of it, identical prices to each other but lower than photo 1, e.g. Sampler Starter $15.95 vs $17.95) and also include one extra item (Money Bag) not on photo 1. Used photo 1 as the primary source for a consistent price set; entrees and curries are priced by protein choice from a shared matrix ($14.95 vegetables up to $23.95 mixed seafood) rather than a single price, so those items omit price.
